g.text: Page load to a rendered App, in the order the code runs, with the branches that fail.
index.html has already set the theme, before first paint
The diagnostics hub is built first
the runtime adopts this hub rather than making one
The shell installs the page’s one session
a registry that fails to load is a diagnostic, not a crash
developer overrides are read before anything registers
Every entry is normalized on its own
one malformed entry loses only itself
a definition id is the only path the shell claims
The boundary hands the page over
below this the shell renders nothing of its own
one load per container, shared by every waiter
The mount is made by the effect that ends it
token, overlay root, telemetry, Query client, storage
The factory runs once, and is checked
basepath through unchanged; the supplied history itself
The App is on the page
the App owns every URL below its boundary
the message the error carries, its
code, and a Retry button that makes
The chrome stays. Every other App
the whole cost of the failure.
